diff --git a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
index a038e03..987892c 100644
--- a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
+++ b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
@@ -12,7 +12,28 @@ if typing.TYPE_CHECKING: from bbq import BBQ
 
 
 class BBQLevelLX(BBQLevel):
-    """Represents an LX BBQ level."""
+    """Represents an LX BBQ level.
+
+    Every bitmap level is a two-stage segment of the pipeline:
+
+      DEC (start_cycle): pick the child (enque: priority digit; deque:
+                         FFS on the up-to-date row) and issue the
+                         counter read for the chosen child.
+      CNT (end_cycle):   decide whether the child becomes empty and
+                         commit the row (bitmap) update.
+
+    Levels with SRAM counters also use the following stage (WB) to write
+    the updated counter back; their "counter == 1" flags are kept in
+    registers so that the emptiness decision never waits on a RAM read.
+    Levels other than L1 load the op's row one stage before DEC (RL),
+    which coincides with the previous level's CNT stage (SRAM bitmaps
+    are read at the previous level's DEC stage).
+
+    Hazards: the row seen at DEC contains every update of the ops 2 or
+    more ahead, plus the set (enque) of the op directly ahead. Whether
+    the op directly ahead empties its child resolves during the current
+    cycle, so DEC computes both FFS candidates and selects late.
+    """
     def __init__(self, bbq: BBQ, start_cycle: int, level_id: int,
                  sram_bitmap: bool, sram_counters: bool) -> None:
 
@@ -42,29 +63,670 @@ class BBQLevelLX(BBQLevel):
 
     def latency(self) -> int:
         """Latency in cycles."""
-        return 1 + int(self.sram_bitmap) + int(self.sram_counters)
+        return 1
+
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Helpers
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @property
+    def is_first(self) -> bool:
+        """Returns whether this is the first bitmap level."""
+        return not isinstance(self.prev_level, BBQLevelLX)
+
+
+    @property
+    def dec(self) -> int:
+        """Decision stage."""
+        return self.start_cycle
+
+
+    @property
+    def cnt(self) -> int:
+        """Commit stage."""
+        return self.start_cycle + 1
+
+
+    def s(self, sig: str, cycle: int) -> str:
+        """Level-local signal name."""
+        return "{}_{}_s{}".format(self.name(), sig, cycle)
+
+
+    def r(self, sig: str, cycle: int) -> str:
+        """Level-local register name."""
+        return "reg_{}_{}_s{}".format(self.name(), sig, cycle)
+
+
+    def digit(self, expr: str) -> str:
+        """This level's priority digit of a priority expression."""
+        hi = self.num_bitmap_levels - self.level_id + 1
+        return "{}[{}*HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1 -: HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH]".format(expr, hi)
+
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def top(expr: str, num_digits: int) -> str:
+        """The most-significant digits of a priority expression."""
+        assert num_digits >= 1
+        return ("{}[HEAP_PRIORITY_BUCKETS_AWIDTH-1 -: {}*HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH]"
+                .format(expr, num_digits))
+
+
+    def row_eq(self, a: int, b: int) -> str:
+        """Ops in stages (a+1), (b+1) are valid and share this level's row."""
+        return "(reg_valid_s[{}] && reg_valid_s[{}] && ({} == {}))".format(
+            a, b, self.top("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(a), self.level_id - 1),
+            self.top("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(b), self.level_id - 1))
+
+
+    def start_comb(self, cg: CodeGen, label: str) -> None:
+        """Start a labelled always_comb block with a local loop variable."""
+        cg.start_block("always_comb")
+        cg.out = cg.out.rstrip("\n") + " : {}_{}\n".format(self.name(), label)
+        cg.emit("integer lx_m;")
+
+
+    @property
+    def ffs_postop_cycles(self) -> typing.List[int]:
+        """Cycles of the FFS post-op inputs referenced by the generator."""
+        num_ffs_insts = 2 + int(self.sram_counters)
+        return [(self.start_cycle + int(self.sram_bitmap) + j - 1)
+                for j in range(1, num_ffs_insts)]
+
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Definitions and state-independent datapath
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def emit_functions(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
+        """Emit helper functions shared by all bitmap levels."""
+        cg.comment("Bitmap-level helper functions", True)
+        cg.emit([
+            "integer lx_r;",
+            "integer lx_b;",
+            "",
+            "// One-hot of the lowest (or highest) set bit",
+            "function automatic bitmap_t lx_ffs_oh(input bitmap_t x, input logic is_max);",
+            "    integer m;",
+            "    bitmap_t lo, hi; // Inclusive prefix (suffix) OR",
+            "    lo = x;",
+            "    hi = x;",
+            "    for (m = 1; m < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH; m = m + m) begin",
+            "        lo = lo | (lo << m);",
+            "        hi = hi | (hi >> m);",
+            "    end",
+            "    lx_ffs_oh = x & ~(is_max ? (hi >> 1) : (lo << 1));",
+            "endfunction",
+            "",
+            "// Index of a one-hot vector",
+            "function automatic logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] lx_oh_idx(input bitmap_t oh);",
+            "    integer m;",
+            "    logic [63:0] mask;",
+            "    lx_oh_idx = 0;",
+            "    if (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH <= 64) begin",
+            "        for (m = 0; m < HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH; m = m + 1) begin",
+            "            mask = ((m == 0) ? 64'haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa : (m == 1) ? 64'hcccccccccccccccc :",
+            "                    (m == 2) ? 64'hf0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0 : (m == 3) ? 64'hff00ff00ff00ff00 :",
+            "                    (m == 4) ? 64'hffff0000ffff0000 : 64'hffffffff00000000);",
+            "            lx_oh_idx[m] = |(oh & mask[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]);",
+            "        end",
+            "    end",
+            "    else begin",
+            "        for (m = 0; m < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH; m = m + 1) begin",
+            "            if (oh[m]) lx_oh_idx = lx_oh_idx | m[HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];",
+            "        end",
+            "    end",
+            "endfunction",
+            "",
+            "// Register counter update (MSb tracks counter >= 2)",
+            "function automatic counter_t lx_cnt_next(input counter_t c, input logic inc);",
+            "    lx_cnt_next[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] = (inc ? (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] + 1'b1) :",
+            "                                             (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] - 1'b1));",
+            "    lx_cnt_next[WATERLEVEL_IDX] = (inc ? (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX] | c[0]) :",
+            "                                         ((|c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:2]) | (&c[1:0])));",
+            "endfunction",
+            "",
+            "function automatic logic lx_is0(input counter_t c);",
+            "    lx_is0 = !c[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && !c[0];",
+            "endfunction",
+            "",
+            "function automatic logic lx_is1(input counter_t c);",
+            "    lx_is1 = !c[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && c[0];",
+            "endfunction",
+            "",
+            "// SRAM counter update (MSb holds counter == 2)",
+            "// (or counter == 1, for levels that read flags from the counter)",
+            "function automatic counter_t lx_c2_next(input counter_t c, input logic inc,",
+            "                                        input logic flag_is_2);",
+            "    lx_c2_next[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] = (inc ? (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] + 1'b1) :",
+            "                                            (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] - 1'b1));",
+            "    lx_c2_next[WATERLEVEL_IDX] = (flag_is_2 ?",
+            "        (inc ? (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] == 1) : (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] == 3)) :",
+            "        (inc ? (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] == 0) : (c[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] == 2)));",
+            "endfunction",
+        ])
+        cg.emit()
 
 
     def emit_stage_defs(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
-        """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""
-        raise NotImplementedError("Bitmap-level implementation removed")
+        """Emit per-stage definitions."""
+        if self.is_first: self.emit_functions(cg)
+
+        name = self.name()
+        dec, cnt = self.dec, self.cnt
+        cg.comment("L{} bitmap level (DEC: S{}, CNT: S{})".format(
+            self.level_id, dec, cnt))
+
+        lw = "logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]"
+        defs = [
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("eff", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("effm", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("oh0", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("oh1", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("dec", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("oh", dec))),
+            (lw, "{};".format(self.s("idx0", dec))),
+            (lw, "{};".format(self.s("idx1", dec))),
+            (lw, "{};".format(self.s("digit", dec))),
+            (lw, "{};".format(self.s("idx", dec))),
+            ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("s1d", dec))),
+            ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("pend", dec))),
+            ("heap_priority_t", "{};".format(self.s("prio", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.r("oh", dec))),
+            ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_pm;".format(name)),
+            ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("z", cnt))),
+            ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("zero", cnt))),
+        ]
+        if self.is_first:
+            defs += [("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_z1f;".format(name))]
+        if not self.is_first:
+            rl = dec - 1
+            wb = cnt + 1
+            defs += [
+                # Row load
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("same1", rl))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("same2", rl))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("load", rl))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("sm1", rl))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("zrl", rl))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_base;".format(name)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.r("zrl", rl))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("s1d", rl))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("same1", rl))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("same2", rl))),
+                # Decision
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("rowsel", dec))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("zrow", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("zero0", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("zero1", dec))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.r("rowsel", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("pend", dec))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_dm;".format(name)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.r("zrow", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("zero0", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("zero1", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("same1", dec))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("same2", dec))),
+                # Commit
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("samec1", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("samec2", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("zsel", cnt))),
+                ("counter_t", "{};".format(self.s("cnt", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("is2", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("selq", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("alt", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("zp", cnt))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.s("fin", cnt))),
+
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_fin;".format(name)),
+                ("counter_t", "{};".format(self.r("cnt", cnt))),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{};".format(self.r("oh", cnt))),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_zp1;".format(name)),
+
+                # Counter write-back
+                ("counter_t", "{};".format(self.s("new", wb))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.s("is2new", wb))),
+                ("counter_t", "{};".format(self.r("new", wb))),
+                ("logic", "{};".format(self.r("is2new", wb))),
+            ]
+            if self.sram_bitmap:
+                defs += [("logic", "{};".format(self.s("same3", rl)))]
+
+        for c in self.ffs_postop_cycles:
+            defs += [("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, c))]
+
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            e = self.end_cycle
+            defs += [
+                ("heap_priority_t", "priority_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, e)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, e)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(name, e)),
+            ]
+            for offset in range(1, 5):
+                defs += [("logic", "pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(e + offset, e))]
+            for offset in range(1, 5):
+                defs += [("logic", "reg_pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(e + offset, e))]
+
+        cg.align_defs(defs)
+        if not self.is_first:
+            k = self.level_id
+            cg.comment([
+                "Counter == 1 flags of the L{} children (and their write mask), kept".format(k),
+                "in registers unless the level is large (then derived from the counter).",
+            ])
+            cg.emit([
+                "localparam LX_ZREG_L{0} = (NUM_COUNTERS_L{0} <= 4096);".format(k),
+                ("localparam LX_ZBITS_L{0} = (LX_ZREG_L{0} ? (NUM_BITMAPS_L{0} * "
+                 "HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH) : HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH);".format(k)),
+                "logic [LX_ZBITS_L{}-1:0] {}_zflat;".format(k, name),
+                "logic [LX_ZBITS_L{}-1:0] {}_zmask;".format(k, name),
+                "logic reg_{}_zp2;".format(name),
+            ])
+        cg.emit()
+
+        for c in self.ffs_postop_cycles:
+            cg.emit("assign reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{} = {};".format(
+                name, c, "l1_bitmap" if self.is_first else "reg_{}_fin".format(name)))
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            cg.emit("assign priority_s{} = reg_priority_s[{}];".format(
+                self.end_cycle, self.end_cycle - 1))
+        cg.emit()
+
+        self.emit_datapath(cg)
+
+
+    def emit_datapath(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
+        """Emit the level's combinational datapath (always_comb blocks)."""
+        name = self.name()
+        dec, cnt = self.dec, self.cnt
+        rl, wb = dec - 1, cnt + 1
+
+        # Row load: one stage before DEC
+        if not self.is_first:
+            cg.comment([
+                "L{}, Stage {}: load the row of the op entering DEC, with".format(
+                    self.level_id, rl),
+                "the set of the op now in DEC (the op 2 ahead is forwarded).",
+            ])
+            cg.start_block("always_comb")
+            cg.emit("{} = {};".format(self.s("same1", rl), self.row_eq(rl - 1, rl)))
+            cg.emit("{} = {};".format(self.s("same2", rl), self.row_eq(rl - 1, rl + 1)))
+            row = self.top("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(rl - 1), self.level_id - 1)
+            if self.sram_bitmap:
+                # The read was issued at the previous stage. The op three
+                # ahead wrote this row at that time; forward its result.
+                cg.emit("{} = {};".format(self.s("same3", rl), self.row_eq(rl - 1, rl + 2)))
+                cg.align_ternary(self.s("load", rl), [self.s("same3", rl)],
+                                 ["reg_{}_fin".format(name), "bm_{}_q".format(name)],
+                                 "=", True, True)
+            else:
+                cg.emit("{} = {}_bitmaps[{}];".format(self.s("load", rl), name, row))
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = ({} && reg_is_enque_s[{}]) ? {} : '0;".format(
+                    self.s("sm1", rl), self.s("same1", rl), rl, self.s("dec", dec)),
+                "{} = {}_zflat[(LX_ZREG_L{} ? {} : 0)*HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH +: HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH];".format(
+                    self.s("zrl", rl), name, self.level_id, row),
+            ])
+            cg.end_block("always_comb")
+            cg.emit()
+
+        # Decision stage
+        cg.comment("L{}, Stage {}: choose the child".format(self.level_id, dec))
+        self.start_comb(cg, "dec_comb")
+        if self.is_first:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = l1_bitmap;".format(self.s("eff", dec)),
+                "{} = reg_valid_s[{}] && !reg_is_enque_s[{}];".format(
+                    self.s("s1d", dec), dec, dec),
+            ])
+        else:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = reg_{}_base;".format(self.s("eff", dec), name),
+                "{} = {};".format(self.s("s1d", dec), self.r("s1d", rl)),
+            ])
+        cg.emit([
+            "{} = {} & ~reg_{}_pm;".format(self.s("effm", dec), self.s("eff", dec), name),
+            "{} = lx_ffs_oh({}, reg_is_deque_max_s[{}]);".format(
+                self.s("oh0", dec), self.s("eff", dec), dec - 1),
+            "{} = lx_ffs_oh({}, reg_is_deque_max_s[{}]);".format(
+                self.s("oh1", dec), self.s("effm", dec), dec - 1),
+            "{} = lx_oh_idx({});".format(self.s("idx0", dec), self.s("oh0", dec)),
+            "{} = lx_oh_idx({});".format(self.s("idx1", dec), self.s("oh1", dec)),
+            "{} = {};".format(self.s("digit", dec), self.digit("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(dec - 1))),
+            "{} = (1 << {});".format(self.s("dec", dec), self.s("digit", dec)),
+            "{} = {} && {};".format(self.s("pend", dec), self.s("s1d", dec), self.s("z", cnt)),
+        ])
+        cg.start_conditional("if", "reg_is_enque_s[{}]".format(dec - 1))
+        cg.emit([
+            "{} = {};".format(self.s("oh", dec), self.s("dec", dec)),
+            "{} = {};".format(self.s("idx", dec), self.s("digit", dec)),
+        ])
+        cg.end_conditional("if")
+        cg.start_conditional("else", None)
+        cg.emit([
+            "{} = {} ? {} : {};".format(self.s("oh", dec), self.s("pend", dec),
+                                        self.s("oh1", dec), self.s("oh0", dec)),
+            "{} = {} ? {} : {};".format(self.s("idx", dec), self.s("pend", dec),
+                                        self.s("idx1", dec), self.s("idx0", dec)),
+        ])
+        cg.end_conditional("else")
+        cg.emit([
+            "{} = reg_priority_s[{}];".format(self.s("prio", dec), dec - 1),
+            "{} = {};".format(self.digit(self.s("prio", dec)), self.s("idx", dec)),
+        ])
+        if not self.is_first:
+            set_mask = "(reg_is_enque_s[{}] ? {} : '0)".format(dec - 1, self.s("dec", dec))
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = ({} & ~({} ? reg_{}_pm : '0)) | {};".format(
+                    self.s("rowsel", dec), self.s("eff", dec), self.s("pend", dec), name, set_mask),
+                "{} = !(|({} & {}));".format(self.s("zero0", dec), self.s("eff", dec),
+                                            self.s("dec", dec)),
+                "{} = !(|({} & {}));".format(self.s("zero1", dec), self.s("effm", dec),
+                                            self.s("dec", dec)),
+            ])
+            # Fold in the flag update of the op 2 ahead (now in WB)
+            cg.emit("{0} = {1} ? (({2} & ~{3}) | (reg_{4}_zp1 ? {3} : '0)) : {2};".format(
+                self.s("zrow", dec), self.r("same2", rl), self.r("zrl", rl),
+                self.r("oh", cnt), name))
+        cg.end_block("always_comb")
+        cg.emit()
+
+        # Commit stage
+        cg.comment("L{}, Stage {}: resolve emptiness and commit the row".format(
+            self.level_id, cnt))
+        self.start_comb(cg, "cnt_comb")
+        if self.is_first and not self.is_leaf:
+            # Only deques use the emptiness flag here (their child is non-empty)
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = |({} & reg_{}_z1f);".format(self.s("z", cnt), self.r("oh", dec), name),
+                "{} = 1'b0;".format(self.s("zero", cnt)),
+            ])
+        elif self.is_first:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = 1'b0;".format(self.s("z", cnt)),
+                "{} = 1'b0;".format(self.s("zero", cnt)),
+            ])
+            cg.start_for("lx_m", "lx_m < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH")
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0} = {0} | ({1}[lx_m] && reg_{2}_z1f[lx_m] && !lx_is0({2}_counters[lx_m]));".format(
+                    self.s("z", cnt), self.r("oh", dec), name),
+                "{0} = {0} | ({1}[lx_m] && lx_is0({2}_counters[lx_m]));".format(
+                    self.s("zero", cnt), self.r("oh", dec), name),
+            ])
+            cg.end_for()
+        else:
+            mine = self.digit("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(cnt - 1))
+            cg.emit([
+                "{} = {} && ({} == {});".format(
+                    self.s("samec1", cnt), self.r("same1", dec), mine,
+                    self.digit("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(cnt))),
+                "{} = {} && ({} == {});".format(
+                    self.s("samec2", cnt), self.r("same2", dec), mine,
+                    self.digit("reg_priority_s[{}]".format(cnt + 1))),
+                "{} = |({} & {});".format(self.s("zsel", cnt), self.r("oh", dec),
+                                         self.r("zrow", dec)),
+                "{} = reg_is_enque_s[{}] && ({} ? {} : {});".format(
+                    self.s("zero", cnt), dec, self.r("pend", dec),
+                    self.r("zero1", dec), self.r("zero0", dec)),
+                # Register flags of empty children may be stale after a reset;
+                # counter flags are re-initialized with the counters.
+                "{} = ({} ? reg_{}_zp1 : !LX_ZREG_L{} ? ({} ? reg_{}_zp2 :".format(
+                    self.s("z", cnt), self.s("samec1", cnt), name, self.level_id,
+                    self.s("samec2", cnt), name),
+                "    counter_{}_q[WATERLEVEL_IDX]) : ({} && !{}));".format(
+                    name, self.s("zsel", cnt), self.s("zero", cnt)),
+            ])
